  sudo -u opsadmin -H ssh -o UserKnownHostsFile="$bad" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o BatchMode=yes local-pinned true >"$out" 2>&1
else
  su -s /bin/sh opsadmin -c "HOME=/home/opsadmin ssh -o UserKnownHostsFile=$bad -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o BatchMode=yes local-pinned true" >"$out" 2>&1
fi
rc=$?
set -e
printf 'post_restart_mismatch_exit=%s\n' "$rc"
grep 'REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED' "$out"
[ "$rc" -eq 255 ]
rm -f "$bad" "$out"
printf 'post_restart_strict_rejection=ok\n'

set -eu
bad=/tmp/opsadmin-known-hosts-postrestart-mismatch
out=/tmp/opsadmin-postrestart-rejection.out
printf '%s,node1 %s\n' "$NODE_IP" "$(cat /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub)" > "$bad"
chown opsadmin:opsadmin "$bad"
chmod 600 "$bad"
set +e
if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -u opsadmin -H ssh -o UserKnownHostsFile="$bad" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o BatchMode=yes local-pinned true >"$out" 2>&1
else
  su -s /bin/sh opsadmin -c "HOME=/home/opsadmin ssh -o UserKnownHostsFile=$bad -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o BatchMode=yes local-pinned true" >"$out" 2>&1
fi
rc=$?
set -e
printf 'post_restart_mismatch_exit=%s\n' "$rc"
grep 'REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED' "$out"
[ "$rc" -eq 255 ]
rm -f "$bad" "$out"
